questions.question: What is released into the atmosphere during photosynthesis?
questions.fact: Photosynthesis results in the release of oxygen into the atmosphere.
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis results in the release of oxygen into the atmosphere.

questions.question: What do the Greek roots of the word heterotroph mean?
questions.fact: The Greek roots of the word heterotroph mean "other" (hetero) "feeder" (troph).
questions.explanation: The Greek roots of heterotroph mean "other" (hetero) "feeder" (troph).

questions.question: What provides most of the energy required by living things on earth?
questions.fact: Photosynthesis provides most of the energy required by living things on earth, directly or indirectly.
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis provides most of the energy required by living things on earth.

questions.question: In that example, what is the plant?
questions.fact: In that example the plant is the only autotroph.
questions.explanation: In that example the plant is the only autotroph.

questions.question: What do certain organisms convert solar energy (sunlight) into through photosynthesis?
questions.fact: Through photosynthesis certain organisms convert solar energy (sunlight) into chemical energy.
questions.explanation: Through photosynthesis certain organisms convert solar energy into chemical energy.
